description: Ranged arcane hunter - spam Huntress Shot and Moon Arrow to build Scattered Stars and mana, cash stacks through Starfire Shot/Lunar Lance/Trueshot. Starcall tags packs and slows.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Starcall, Starfire Shot, Trueshot, Aspect of the Huntress confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: almost every action refunds mana (Moon Arrow's Ishnu-alah, Aspect of the Huntress off autos, star-consuming finishers), so the spec rarely sits down to drink while actively fighting.

nodes.name: Keen Sight
nodes.description: Increases ranged Attack Power and hit rating from Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Sentinel - Level 15 Passive. Ranged AP + hit rating from Intellect.'

nodes.name: Huntress Training
nodes.description: Grants haste rating from Intellect at 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Eye of Elune
nodes.description: Increases critical strike chance by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Lunar Focus
nodes.description: Increases Hit rating by 2 per rank.

nodes.name: Explosive Moonlight
nodes.description: Huntress Shot and Moon Arrow have a 12% chance per rank to detonate in moonlight, searing the target for 45 Arcane damage each turn for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 30 Passive. Ranged AP + hit rating from Intellect.'

nodes.name: True Aim
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of Moon Arrow by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Astral Quickness
nodes.description: Moon Arrow critical strikes restore 25 Energy, enough for another shot. No more than once per turn.

nodes.name: Starfury
nodes.description: Increases critical strike damage by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Arrows In The Night
nodes.description: Huntress Shot has a 20% chance per rank to burst in the dark, adding 30% of its damage again.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Huntress Shots strike extra enemies + explode for Arcane damage; Starcall damage reduces this ability's cooldown.'

nodes.name: Aspect of the Cosmos
nodes.description: Melee and ranged damage has a chance to slow the target, stacking, and apply Scattered Stars. Only 1 Aspect active at a time.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed (class-wide list): 'Melee/ranged damage chance to slow target (stacking) + apply Scattered Stars. Shares Aspect cooldown.' Sentinel's real kite/control tool.

nodes.name: Lunar Splinters
nodes.description: Increases Starfire Shot, Lunar Lance and Trueshot damage by 5% per rank.

nodes.name: Celestial Shot
nodes.description: Each Starfire Shot is followed by a free Moon Arrow, no more than once per turn.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 40 Passive. Boosts Scattered Star consumption effectiveness.'

nodes.name: Lo'sho Amplification
nodes.description: Starfire Shot and Trueshot burn the stars you scattered, restoring 90 Mana. No more than once per turn.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 50 Passive. Scattered Stars burn enemy mana.'

nodes.name: Drawstring of Elune
nodes.description: Huntress Shot and Starcall have a 20% chance per rank to scatter a star across the target, reducing its Armor by 12 per stack. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Huntress Shot/Starcall apply extra Scattered Star stack; boosts ability range to 50 yds.'

nodes.name: Star-Guided Arrows
nodes.description: Huntress Shot and Moon Arrow have a 15% chance to guide a free Trueshot at the target. No more than once every 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Scattered Star damage chance to refresh a Trueshot charge.'

nodes.name: Cascade
nodes.description: Every Huntress Shot and Moon Arrow cascades starlight into your next cast, increasing damage dealt by 3% for 3 turns. Stacks up to 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Sentinel's real capstone payoff: 'Every 8th consumed star boosts next Starcall's damage.'

nodes.name: Huntress Saber
nodes.description: Learn Huntress Saber, a mount granting increased movement speed, slow immunity, and the ability to cast offensive spells while moving.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Sentinel's real mobility/repositioning tool: 'Mount: +movement speed, slow immunity, cast offensive spells while moving/without dismounting.'

nodes.name: Starlight
nodes.description: Learn Starlight, a beam that repeatedly deals Arcane damage and slows enemies passing through.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Beam: repeating Arcane damage + slows enemies passing through.'

nodes.name: Rain of Comets
nodes.description: Learn Rain of Comets, a repeating AoE Arcane damage effect at a target area.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Repeating AoE Arcane damage at target area.'

nodes.name: Stellar Drift
nodes.description: Learn Stellar Drift, slowing nearby enemies and then knocking them back. Each rank reduces its cooldown by 4%.
